pages.title: Finding the Hidden Grid
pages.text: Modular equipment is deliberately incomplete until its grid is filled. Carry a modular item, use the configurable $(thing)Tool Modules$() keybind (default: Shift+C), then select the host and place modules.$(br2)Shapes, install limits, compatible hosts, and maximum tiers all matter; the grid rejects an impossible placement.

pages.title: Common Module Families
pages.text: $(bold)All powered hosts:$() energy.$(br)$(bold)Tools and staff:$() damage, speed, mining area, tree harvest, junk filtering.$(br)$(bold)Chestpiece:$() shield control/capacity/recovery, movement, flight, undying, auto-feed.$(br)$(bold)Bow:$() projectile damage, velocity, accuracy, penetration, and gravity compensation.

pages.title: Measure Before Committing
pages.text: Higher-tier modules often occupy more space, so the grandest module is not always the best fit. Place required controls—Shield Control, for example—before capacity and recovery.$(br2)Read each module's description and compare its grid shape and limits before spending Fusion materials.
